messages:
morgan: Quick heads-up — ran the nightly kb link crawl and picked up ~15 internal 404s across /runbooks and /kb/ops. Not critical but a few are in the SRE playbooks that matter for on-call. :eyes:
linkscanner (bot): Automated scan report: 15 broken internal links, severity: low-medium. Report: https://infra/reports/1733456789
alex: Can you paste the grep/command you used? want to run locally before assigning.
morgan: sure — ran:
```
rg -n "(https?://internal\.redwood/|/kb/|/runbooks/)" content/ | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -n1 curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %url\n"
```
sam: i'll take the runbooks slice (first 7). tagging @jess in case any are hers. :hand:
jess: thanks @sam — i own deploy/troubleshooting and a couple of incident runbooks. i can do a quick sweep tonight.
alex: Can we prioritize anything referenced in the incident runbook? low-latency docs first. Also, if a link is to an external gist we should rehost.
morgan: plan: sam + jess cover the SRE runbooks, i'll open a single PR with fixes and redirects for the rest, and we can queue the rehosts as separate PRs. Will add a checklist in the PR description for owners to approve.
sam: ack. i'll start with runbook ids: RB-212, RB-214, RB-220. will post findings as comments in the PR.
jess: FYI — two of the links are to the old internal onboarding doc. i'll add redirects to the new one instead of deleting links.
alex: thanks — if anyone needs a quick review from docs, ping me. :thumbsup:
